desc:
Amb. T meets RiRi! 
Ambassador Taglialatela and @rihanna explored collaboration between the @ClaraLionelFdn and the Embassy on women #entrepreneurship and #climatechange.

It was a good conversation between two powerful women and we’re very happy they were able to meet!
